title: php-bin reviewed policy invariants
description: The owner-reviewed release invariants in autorelease/policy-invariants.json. support-policy.json binds to the file's exact digest (policyInvariantsDigest), and mise-php's consumer and readiness records carry that digest, so any edit is a coordinated change in both repositories.

targets.description: Every platform each release publishes an archive for, in release platform order (macos-aarch64, linux-x86_64, linux-aarch64). A release missing any of them publishes nothing.
